title: The King of Fighters '98
subtitle: A dream match for the whole cast
summary: The King of Fighters '98 is SNK's team fighting game, first released for Neo Geo MVS on 23 July 1998.
body: The King of Fighters '98 is SNK's team fighting game, first released for Neo Geo MVS on 23 July 1998. After the previous game's conclusion of the Orochi story, it gathers a broad selection of returning fighters for a dream match. Players assemble teams of three, bringing together characters from across the series' first five editions. Rugal returns as the final opponent, while several fighters offer alternative versions with earlier move sets. The emphasis falls on the pleasure and possibilities of the assembled cast, giving the tournament the character of a celebration.

Two systems, Advance and Extra, provide different ways to manage movement and the power gauge. The choice changes the framework around a fighter's individual moves, allowing the player to favour an approach learned in another entry. Losing a teammate also grants a compensating advantage: Advance increases the remaining capacity for stored power, while Extra makes charging easier and changes access to stronger techniques. A reduced team can therefore retain the means to recover, keeping the later rounds dangerous even after an opponent has established an early lead.

The roster's breadth gives team construction a lasting purpose. A player can return to favourites, experiment with another order or combine characters whose strengths address different situations. Alternate versions extend that exploration within a familiar face. Director Toyohisa Tanabe and the team considered returning characters with input from players, making the selection part of the game's identity. Later adaptations and Ultimate Match expanded its life, but the original already offered the central attraction: a large, carefully connected fighting cast whose combinations could sustain repeated contests after the story arc had finished.
